effects: The signer sends `assets` ftUSD (0xFcfacB1A…, 6 decimals) to the vault through transferFrom, spending the signer's ftUSD allowance to the vault.
The vault puts the ftUSD into the yield wrapper; this does not change what the signer gets.
The vault mints `assets` sftUSD shares (1:1) to `receiver`, who may be another address than the signer.
The vault checkpoints the FT reward accrual of `receiver`; the new stake starts to earn FT rewards for `receiver`.
The function is not payable; no native value leaves.
formats.shown: "Stake 9.020293 ftUSD" with the Amount in ftUSD and the Receiver address as a field.

findings.title: deposit interpolatedIntent omits the receiver who gets the staked position and its rewards.
findings.evidence: Descriptor deposit format: "interpolatedIntent": "Stake {assets}"; EpochRewardsVault.sol deposit: `_deposit(msg.sender, receiver, assets, shares, msg.sender, 0)` and `_mint(to, shares)`. The receiver is only in a separate field.

findings.title: deposit does not name the sftUSD shares that the receiver gets.
findings.evidence: EpochRewardsVault.sol `__ERC20_init("Staked Flying Tulip USD", "sftUSD")`, `_convertToShares` returns `assets`; `_mint(to, shares)`. The screen only says "Stake ftUSD". Shares are 1:1, so the amount is implied.
findings.fix: Optionally add to the intent or a label that the receiver gets sftUSD 1:1.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns `assets` sftUSD shares (1:1) from `owner`; when the signer is not `owner`, it spends the signer's sftUSD allowance from `owner`.
The vault settles the FT reward accrual of `owner` before the burn; settled FT stays claimable.
The vault calls yieldWrapper.withdraw(assets, receiver): `receiver` gets `assets` ftUSD now, or a queue entry in the yield wrapper (queue id returned, 0 when immediate).
The function is not payable; no native value leaves.
formats.shown: "Unstake 9.020293 ftUSD" with the Amount in ftUSD, the Receiver and the Owner addresses as fields.

findings.title: withdraw interpolatedIntent omits the receiver of the ftUSD and the owner whose shares burn.
findings.evidence: Descriptor withdraw format: "interpolatedIntent": "Unstake {assets}"; EpochRewardsVault.sol `_withdrawWithQueueIds`: `_burn(owner, shares)` and `yieldWrapper.withdraw(assets, receiver)`.

findings.title: withdraw can create a yield wrapper queue entry instead of sending ftUSD now; screen implies immediate ftUSD.
findings.evidence: EpochRewardsVault.sol `_withdrawWithQueueIds`: `queueIdTo = yieldWrapper.withdraw(assets, receiver);` and the natspec of withdrawWithQueueId: "return the yield wrapper queue ID (0 when immediate)". The yield wrapper source is not in the directory, so the queue rules cannot be checked.
findings.fix: Consider an intent such as "Unstake ftUSD (may be queued)" once the yield wrapper behaviour is confirmed.

findings.title: withdraw test only covers owner equal to receiver; the allowance path for a third-party owner is untested.
findings.evidence: cases/1.json: Receiver and Owner are both 0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045; EpochRewardsVault.sol `if (spender != owner) { _spendAllowance(owner, spender, shares); }`.
findings.fix: Add a case where owner differs from the signer and from the receiver.

effects: The vault settles the signer's FT reward accrual over all settled epochs.
The vault sends FT (0x55Ec65…) to `to`: the signer's whole accrued amount, or the vault's FT balance when that is smaller; the rest stays accrued.
The open (unsettled) epoch is not included in the payout.
The function is not payable; no native value leaves.
formats.shown: "Claim FT to 0xd8dA…6045" with the Recipient as a field; no amount.

findings.title: claim amount comes from storage, so the screen cannot show how much FT the recipient gets.
findings.evidence: EpochRewardsVault.sol `_claim`: `uint256 claimable = user.ftAccrued;` `uint256 paidGross = claimable <= bal ? claimable : bal;` `FT.safeTransfer(to, paidToUser);`. Descriptor claim format has only the `to` field.

couldNotCheck: The yield wrapper 0x2e37BAC5b6535ff1A8e6AE07Fbd4005A40928Dc7 (IftYieldWrapperV2) has no source in the directory. withdraw calls yieldWrapper.withdraw(assets, receiver), which decides whether the receiver gets ftUSD now or a queue entry, and how much.
